messages.text: Hey Jordan! Good morning, how did you sleep?
Morning Alex! Pretty well, thanks. Did you finish that presentation last night?
Yeah, wrapped it up around midnight. Honestly feeling a little nervous about today.
You're going to do great! You put so much thought into it. Remember slide 4 is your strongest point.
Thanks so much, that really helps calm my nerves :)
Quick update: the presentation went really well! The team loved the direction.
YES! I knew you'd crush it! So proud of you!
Could not have done it without your encouragement. Are we still on for dinner on Friday?
Definitely! Let's try that Italian place downtown.
Hey, are you free for a quick call?
In a meeting until 3, but can call right after! Everything okay?
Yeah, just got some weird news from my manager, nothing urgent. Call me when you're out.
Calling now!
Hey, are you on your way? We were supposed to meet at 7:00 and it's 7:25.
Oh no, traffic on 4th street is completely stopped. I should have texted sooner, so sorry!
You are completely right, Jordan. I was rushing and didn't check the time. I apologize, I'll be more considerate.
Thank you for understanding. See you when you get here.
Dinner was really nice despite the rough start. Glad we talked it through.
Me too. I really appreciate how honest you are with me. Have a restful night!
Goodnight Alex! Sleep well :)
